definitions.explanation: Not healthy or wholesome, either physically, mentally, or morally. Used for conditions, environments, relationships, finances, or content deemed harmful or improper.

examples.japanese: {不健全|ふけんぜん}な{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}る。
この{内容|ないよう}は{青少年|せいしょうねん}に{不健全|ふけんぜん}だ。
examples.english: This content is unwholesome for young people.

examples.japanese: {不健全|ふけんぜん}な{財政|ざいせい}{状態|じょうたい}が{長|なが}く{続|つづ}くと、{経営|けいえい}が{危|あや}うくなる。
examples.english: If an unsound financial condition continues for a long time, management will be at risk.

notes:
The negated form of {健全|けんぜん} (healthy, sound), created by adding the prefix {不|ふ} (un-, non-). Functions as a な-adjective.

FORMS:
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な + noun — attributive (unwholesome ~)
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}だ — predicative (is unwholesome)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な{生活|せいかつ} — unhealthy lifestyle
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な{環境|かんきょう} — unwholesome environment
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な{関係|かんけい} — unhealthy relationship
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な{財政|ざいせい} — unsound finances
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}{図書|としょ} — unwholesome publications (official term in content regulation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {健全|けんぜん} — healthy; sound; wholesome (the positive form)
- {不衛生|ふえいせい} — unsanitary; unhygienic (focuses on cleanliness)
- {有害|ゆうがい} — harmful; noxious (stronger, implies actual damage)
